button.label: Run
button.supertip: Validate every input, calculate the EAD of every netting set and write Results, HedgingSets, Buckets, TradeCalc, Checks and both reconciliations.

button.label: Run SA-CCR
button.supertip: Validate every input and calculate.

button.label: Validate inputs
button.supertip: Clear the outputs and check every input; the findings are listed on Checks. Nothing is calculated.

button.label: Clear outputs
button.supertip: Empty the five output tables and both reconciliations.

menu.label: Import CSV
menu.supertip: Load a CSV file onto its staging sheet as text. The input sheets do not change until Commit import.

button.label: NettingSets file...
button.supertip: Load a NettingSets CSV file onto Import_NettingSets.

button.label: Trades file...
button.supertip: Load a Trades CSV file onto Import_Trades.

button.label: Validate staging
button.supertip: Check the staged rows of both staging sheets against the CSV contract, each other, the input sheets and Params; the findings are listed on Checks.

button.label: Commit import
button.supertip: Replace NettingSets, Trades or both with the staged rows of a VALID validation that still holds. Nothing is calculated until Run.

menu.label: Templates
menu.supertip: Write blank CSV templates or the import specification.

button.label: NettingSets template...
button.supertip: Write the blank NettingSets CSV template, its header line alone.

button.label: Trades template...
button.supertip: Write the blank Trades CSV template, its header line alone.

button.label: Import specification...
button.supertip: Save one HTML page describing both CSV files, every column, rule and finding code, with an example of each file.

button.label: Export evidence
button.supertip: Write the evidence CSV of the current run. Refused while the results are out of date or edited.

button.label: Restore parameters
button.supertip: Put the reference parameters and the supervisory-factor table back to the regulatory set, so the next run is REGULATORY. The reporting date, currency, regime and FX table are not changed.

labelControl.supertip: Whether Results still describes the current inputs, as Results C5 says.
The status of Import_NettingSets, as its cell D7 says.
The status of Import_Trades, as its cell D7 says.

button.label: Go to
button.supertip: Open Home. The arrow lists every sheet.
